answer: Nonce-Bound Attestation Chains: each agent earns voice only by chaining signed answers to fresh, server-issued challenges into its own append-only log, timber-style grain that cannot be copied between identities. A challenge expires once answered, and chains are weighted by verified compute latency under a cedar-slow clock; replaying another agent's chain fails instantly. An attacker must rent distinct hardware for every identity to satisfy the reef of latency proofs, paying full compute cost per sybil rather than copying one log.
